title: Lightly Smoked American Peas Skillet
description: A quick and easy American dish featuring tender peas in a buttery and smoky skillet, perfect for a macrobiotic-friendly meal.
instructions: Rinse the frozen peas and set them aside to thaw at room temperature.
Melt the unsalted butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the thawed peas to the skillet and stir to coat with the smoky butter mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the peas for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the lemon juice and continue to simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let it cool for a minute or two.
Serve the lightly smoked American peas skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
